title: Apple Calendar deleted all my events without warning.
body:
I used Apple Calendar on my iPhone as my main and only place to store all important events, work, bookings, plans — basically my entire life schedule.
One day, all events just disappeared. No warning. No confirmation. No recovery.

iCloud calendar is empty. Sync is unstable. Sometimes there are warning icons, sometimes not. Support offers generic steps, but the data itself is just gone.

This happened shortly after I updated my MacBook to a new macOS version. I can’t say for sure that the update was the direct cause, but the timing is concerning.

This is extremely dangerous for an app that people trust with critical information.
If you use Apple Calendar, make external backups. Do not rely on it as your only source.

Losing years of data like this is unacceptable.

title: Compatibility is really bad
body:
I prefer native apple apps, but calendar is quite troublesome with support. Most people use the Google calendar and I have to use delegated Google calendars for work.

Sometimes there are trouble syncing with delegated calendars and the biggest issue is that calendars do not support HTML syntax like Google Calendar, so all work meeting descriptions are worthless with this app, since you have to really go through HTML syntax than your important notes.

I would love this app, but Apple, please wake up! Start making it compatible with biggest calendar/email provider in the world. I personally don't like Google, but damn, I need that compatibility in my work life
